scope.description: Operating guidance, protocol invariants, and additive linked-correction projections. This reviewer did not author these changed files.
excluded: Receipt-helper implementation authored by this reviewer.
Privacy implementation and the preservation seed, reviewed separately.
Product behavior, native qualification, Wave approval and release.

criteria.evidence: Routing preserves immutable original tasks, adopted amendments and historical GRR/GCR records; new authority expansion and release still require their existing approvals. The added correction guide matches the implemented spec, command, paused/current-unreleased boundary, and integration-review fields.

Guidance requires complete unchanged inputs and independently trusted provenance for reuse, marks incomplete runtime closure fresh-only, prohibits cached Wave/native/performance claims in the pilot, retains adverse attempts, and distinguishes measured time from unavailable cost.

Correction identity, origin, status, inherited criteria, bounded paths and append-only review history are projected without changing the original task or inventing a slice. Absent corrections contribute no new output.

Pending corrections contribute to Wave delivery status and active-work summaries. The actual controller denies corrective admission when Wave completion is REVIEW or APPROVED, so the legacy approved-completion shortcut cannot supersede a legally pending correction.
Human-readable values are escaped; exact correction projections, counts and identity/origin/status markers are validated, and inherited deterministic regeneration detects altered visible content.

checks.provenance: Reviewer executed before candidate commit. The 18 reviewed scope files were byte-identical before/after; the later guide-only addition was separately reviewed. All final reviewed bytes were rebound to the candidate. This is not a claim of a complete transitive runtime cache closure.
Read-only in-memory synthetic probes; no generated site or repository mutation.

checks.scope: One combined binding check covered these 18 paths plus the three separately reviewed WF4 paths.
checks.provenance: Actual raw SHA-256 values equal the frozen review inputs; git --no-replace-objects show for each explicitly named candidate path equals the actual raw bytes. Candidate and HEAD were exact.

Root reported its actual fresh combined affected-unit run at the fixed candidate with production inputs frozen. Supplemental to this reviewer's independently executed focused checks; not relabeled as reviewer execution.

notes: The full task-drilldown generation suite was not redundantly replayed by this reviewer; root separately reported its earlier nine-test generation run, and this review covers the changed correction helpers and their integration call sites.
The final guide-only addition has SHA-256 2a838aca3ab7fc5b77d1b9c42c843ca6ae9b69c0a24f880307f1bf0b69b37e9b. It introduces no new approval or private-field exception.
No protected witness contents, sibling workspace, native application or ordinary user projects were accessed.
limitations: This is an independent component disposition, not approval of the receipt helper, all maintenance components, a product task, W1, or G1.
No benchmark, full deployment profile, or native/platform proof is inferred from these tests.
